messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

### Recommended focus
R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing, covering LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD, with FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing and fading propagation conditions [1][2].
The 5G device testing value chain explicitly includes chip vendors and spans Lab, R&D, Production, Operations and Use cases, with RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance approval, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol and service/repair test types [4][32].
CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control [2].
For application-layer validation, CMX500 application options include internal IP services and DUT IP-connection application tests such as DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput and Max Throughput Wizard; enhanced features include QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP traffic analysis, IMS voice codecs, POLQA, WAV player/recorder and end-to-end audio delay [3].
For semiconductor-relevant NTN validation, R&S reports NR-NTN measurements conducted on R&S TS8980, R&S TS-RRM and R&S CMX500 in NR FR1, with validation covering RF, RRM and PCT domains defined in 3GPP Release 17, using a Samsung NR-NTN chipset as DUT [14].
### Product and capability mapping
| Product line | Capabilities to map to semiconductor needs | Knowledge-base confirmed option / specification | Why it matters | Evidence | Gap / risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Multi-RAT cellular signaling, one-box network emulation, RF and measurement testing | LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing, fading propagation conditions [1][2] | Chip vendors are part of the 5G device testing value chain, which includes signaling, RF, application, OTA, pre-conformance and conformance test types [4][32] | [1][2][4][32] | The passages do not rank these capabilities by importance. |
| R&S CMX500 application/IP/audio features | Application test, IP services, throughput, IMS, voice quality, audio delay | CMX-KA100, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA150, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA181 and CMX-KA401 are described with IP services, QoS/ePDG/N3IWF, IP analysis, IMS codecs, POLQA and WAV/audio-delay functions [3] | Application testing is listed as a 5G device value-chain test type [31][32] | [3][31][32] | Pricing, order configuration and semiconductor-specific package mapping are not stated. |
| R&S CMX500 WLAN / Wi‑Fi signaling | WLAN signaling and TX measurement, Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling, Wi‑Fi/cellular interworking | WLAN signaling covers 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [2]; CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing includes signaling mode, real-world RF TX/RX characteristics, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [17] | R&S positions CMX500 as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester for testing cellular and non-cellular standards in a single-instrument setup [17] | [2][17] | The passages do not explicitly say “semiconductor Wi‑Fi chipset validation” for this row. |
| R&S CMX500 / CMX500 OBT for OTA signaling | 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling integration | MVG integration supports full WLAN signaling including Wi‑Fi 7, 4G, 5G, 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA EN-DC, RedCap and LTE FDD/TDD in OTA systems [19][20] | OTA testing is listed in the 5G device testing value chain [31][32] | [19][20][31][32] | The passages do not specify chamber BOM, pricing or semiconductor-specific validation flow. |
| R&S TS8980 + R&S TS-RRM + R&S CMX500 | NR-NTN conformance and validation | Measurements were conducted on R&S TS8980, R&S TS-RRM and R&S CMX500 in NR FR1; validation covers RF, RRM and PCT domains under 3GPP Release 17 [14] | The cited validation used a Samsung NR-NTN chipset as DUT [14] | [14] | Specific RRM test case IDs and system division of labor are not stated [15]. |

|---|---|---|---|
| Cellular modem / chipset R&D bring-up | R&S CMX500 | Use CMX500 as the one-box signaling tester for LTE, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, NR/LTE signaling, RF measurements, fading, throughput and automation [1][2] | Semiconductor-specific package and priority ranking are not stated. |
| Application and IP-stack validation | R&S CMX500 with CMX-KA100 / KA110 / KA150 / KA180 / KA181 / KA401 where applicable | Validate DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, IP traffic, IMS voice codecs, POLQA and audio delay [3] | Required license bundle for a specific customer is not stated. |
| NR-NTN chipset / conformance preparation | R&S TS8980 + R&S TS-RRM + R&S CMX500 | Use the R&S conformance setup context where NR-NTN FR1 measurements cover RF, RRM and PCT domains and have been conducted with a Samsung NR-NTN chipset DUT [14] | Concrete RRM test case IDs and platform split are not stated [15]. |

【推論】For semiconductor teams acting as chip vendors in the 5G device value chain, CMX500 should be positioned around multi-RAT signaling and network emulation because chip-vendor workflows include signaling/protocol/application/OTA/conformance test types and CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD signaling/device testing capabilities [1][2][4][32].

The 5G device testing value chain explicitly includes chip vendors and spans Lab, R&D, Production, Operations and Use cases, with RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance approval, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol and service/repair test types [4][32].
CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control [2].
For application-layer validation, CMX500 application options include internal IP services and DUT IP-connection application tests such as DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput and Max Throughput Wizard; enhanced features include QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP traffic analysis, IMS voice codecs, POLQA, WAV player/recorder and end-to-end audio delay [3].

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。

- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。

- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

Wi-Fi 8 › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMP180 的關係
[[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 已加入 newly added [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] testing capabilities，並將在 [[MWC Barcelona 2026]] 驗證 [[Broadcom]] prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。

[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則在較早 MWC 2024 語境中，把 [[R&S CMP180]] 的 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform loopback demonstration 描述為 potential [[Wi-Fi 8]] candidate，並將 [[R&S CMP180]] 定位為 future-proof R&D / production tester。

這兩種說法層次不同：[[R&S CMX500]] 來源是 Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests / prototype device demonstration；[[R&S CMP180]] 來源是 480 MHz waveform loopback / candidate demonstration。

Wi-Fi 8
[[Wi-Fi 8]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] 中對 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment 的市場 / 技術稱呼；該來源描述其重點從提高 throughput 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）connectivity performance。較早的 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 則把 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 稱為 yet-to-be-defined，並提到 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion 與 480 MHz WLAN waveform potential candidate。

⚠️ [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]（MWC 2024；發布日期來源未標示）說 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 尚未定義，且 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion，並稱 480 MHz [[WLAN]] waveform 是 potential waveform candidate，但既有頁面 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 說依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]] Wi‑Fi 8 保留 up to 320 MHz channel bandwidth。判斷：前者是較早期 discussion / candidate，後者是較晚 PR 的 implemented signaling-test description；先並列，不把 480 MHz 寫成 Wi‑Fi 8 正式規格。

Wi-Fi 8 › 來源中的技術定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]：

- [[IEEE 802.11bn]] amendment introduces advancements focused on consistent, high-quality connectivity across dense environments。
- 目標應用包含 growing number of connected devices、VR/AR、8K streaming、industrial IoT。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] builds upon [[Wi-Fi 7]] foundation。
- 來源明示 final IEEE standard ratification 尚未完成；[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的測試是在 ratification 前展示。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 在 MWC 2024 語境下仍是 yet-to-be-defined standard。
- 來源稱 even wider channel bandwidths are in discussion。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform loopback mode verification，並稱該 waveform 是 [[Wi-Fi 8]] potential waveform candidate。

Anritsu MX844030PC › Post-silicon / IoT device test
- 用於 [[IoT]] device、communication module 的 basic protocol test。
- 來源稱 software-based solution 有 development efficiency、cost efficiency、future expandability 優勢。
- 可從 sample scenarios 設定 parameters / [[Test Procedure]]，並透過 report / log 顯示支援 device verification 與 analysis。
- 來源列出用途包含 [[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等。

Anritsu MX844030PC › 產品定位
依 [[mx844030pc-j1200]]（2026-02-10，No. MX844030PC-J-A-1-(2.00)），[[Anritsu MX844030PC]] 是 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 的 software component，也被描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution。

來源宣稱它可在 PC 上重現 protocol stack layers，例如：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源的敘事重點是減少硬體依賴、降低成本、提高 test efficiency、降低 risk、建立 flexible scenario，並支援 [[Beyond 5G]] / [[6G]] 方向下的 virtualized testing。

Anritsu MX844030PC › RF / accessory items

- MD8190A-001 — 0.4-6GHz TRX RF Unit。
- [[MX819020A]] — Virtual Signalling Tester RF Platform。
- MX819020A-020 — RF Interface For NR RedCap。
- MX844030PC-AK001 — Standard PC for Virtual Signalling Tester。
- [[Z1320G]] — Standard PC for RTD with monitor。
- [[MT8000A-AK003]] — IP Test Server PC。

- [[J1440A]] — LAN Cable。
- [[G0408A]] — 10 Gig Ethernet SR 850nm SFP+。
- [[J1581A]] — Optical cable MM LC/PC to LC/PC 3 meter。

Virtual Signalling Tester › Post-silicon testing
- 適用 [[IoT]] device 與 communication module 的 basic protocol test。
- 支援快速 functional test、regression test、sample scenario parameterization、test procedure 與 report / log display。
- 來源列出 [[5G RedCap]]、Automotive、Healthcare、Industrial IoT、Smart Cities 等應用語境。

Virtual Signalling Tester
[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu 對 virtualized protocol stack test solution 的產品 / 解決方案語彙，核心是用 PC-based software protocol simulator 建立 NR / RedCap protocol test environment。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 與 Virtual tester 的區分
[[Virtual tester]] 在 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 中是 R&S AI Workplace questionnaire 的 agentic workflow concept，跨 implementation、test、debug、validation。

[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 則是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu NR / RedCap protocol simulation and test product / solution 語彙。兩者名稱相近，但目前沒有來源支持它們是同一產品、同一架構或同一市場分類。

5G device testing value chain › 測試類型
來源列出的測試類型包含：

- [[RF]]。
- [[Signaling]]。
- [[Application testing]]。
- [[OTA testing]]。
- [[Pre-conformance testing]]。
- [[Conformance approval]]。
- [[Carrier acceptance]]。
- [[Non-signaling RF]]。
- [[Signaling Protocol]]。
- [[Service and repair]]。

5G device testing value chain
[[5G device testing value chain]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中整理的 5G device ecosystem 測試分工：從 chip vendor、device manufacturer、test house 到 network operator，依 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases 串接 RF、signaling、application、OTA、pre-conformance、conformance、carrier acceptance 與 service / repair 測試。

5G device testing value chain › Shuffler 與 CMsequencer
來源描述 [[Shuffler]] 可在 one go 執行 device 支援 UE band combos 的 RF / throughput test，並以 one test script with one test report 取得 RF TX/RX measurement、RX sensitivity、Throughput、VoLTE / VoNR 等 summarized results。來源說：

- Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處為 solution overview；[[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 的正式 feature list、order number、CSW version 與 supported bands 仍需正式 R&S 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › CMX500 platform overview
來源對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 platform overview 說法包含：

- Future proof 5G signaling test platform。
- Running on Linux：faster and more robust。
- Single web-based GUI for RF、protocol、application testing。
- Modular and scalable HW architecture。
- LTE & FR1：up to 8 GHz。
- FR2：24–50 GHz。
- Ready for up to 20 Gbps and more E2E IP performance。
- Extensive IP and Application Test feature set onboard。

此處屬 presentation claim；不能取代 formal frequency range、hardware configuration、software option 或 guaranteed performance 規格。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler
來源描述 [[Shuffler]]：

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。
- All Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。
- Band combinations input via UE capabilities or user-defined Excel sheet。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處仍需正式 [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

### Recommended focus
R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing, covering LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD, with FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing and fading propagation conditions [1][2].
The 5G device testing value chain explicitly includes chip vendors and spans Lab, R&D, Production, Operations and Use cases, with RF, signaling, application, OTA, pre-conformance, conformance approval, carrier acceptance, non-signaling RF, signaling protocol and service/repair test types [4][32].
CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT / NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI, graphical scripting, Python-based XLAPI and SCPI remote control [2].
For application-layer validation, CMX500 application options include internal IP services and DUT IP-connection application tests such as DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput and Max Throughput Wizard; enhanced features include QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP traffic analysis, IMS voice codecs, POLQA, WAV player/recorder and end-to-end audio delay [3].
For semiconductor-relevant NTN validation, R&S reports NR-NTN measurements conducted on R&S TS8980, R&S TS-RRM and R&S CMX500 in NR FR1, with validation covering RF, RRM and PCT domains defined in 3GPP Release 17, using a Samsung NR-NTN chipset as DUT [14].
### Product and capability mapping
| Product line | Capabilities to map to semiconductor needs | Knowledge-base confirmed option / specification | Why it matters | Evidence | Gap / risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | Multi-RAT cellular signaling, one-box network emulation, RF and measurement testing | LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, TDD, FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing, fading propagation conditions [1][2] | Chip vendors are part of the 5G device testing value chain, which includes signaling, RF, application, OTA, pre-conformance and conformance test types [4][32] | [1][2][4][32] | The passages do not rank these capabilities by importance. |
| R&S CMX500 application/IP/audio features | Application test, IP services, throughput, IMS, voice quality, audio delay | CMX-KA100, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA150, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA181 and CMX-KA401 are described with IP services, QoS/ePDG/N3IWF, IP analysis, IMS codecs, POLQA and WAV/audio-delay functions [3] | Application testing is listed as a 5G device value-chain test type [31][32] | [3][31][32] | Pricing, order configuration and semiconductor-specific package mapping are not stated. |
| R&S CMX500 WLAN / Wi‑Fi signaling | WLAN signaling and TX measurement, Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling, Wi‑Fi/cellular interworking | WLAN signaling covers 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, 802.11bn and 2x2 MIMO [2]; CMX500 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing includes signaling mode, real-world RF TX/RX characteristics, MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band, coexistence and E2E test capabilities [17] | R&S positions CMX500 as a multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester for testing cellular and non-cellular standards in a single-instrument setup [17] | [2][17] | The passages do not explicitly say “semiconductor Wi‑Fi chipset validation” for this row. |
| R&S CMX500 / CMX500 OBT for OTA signaling | 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling integration | MVG integration supports full WLAN signaling including Wi‑Fi 7, 4G, 5G, 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA EN-DC, RedCap and LTE FDD/TDD in OTA systems [19][20] | OTA testing is listed in the 5G device testing value chain [31][32] | [19][20][31][32] | The passages do not specify chamber BOM, pricing or semiconductor-specific validation flow. |
| R&S TS8980 + R&S TS-RRM + R&S CMX500 | NR-NTN conformance and validation | Measurements were conducted on R&S TS8980, R&S TS-RRM and R&S CMX500 in NR FR1; validation covers RF, RRM and PCT domains under 3GPP Release 17 [14] | The cited validation used a Samsung NR-NTN chipset as DUT [14] | [14] | Specific RRM test case IDs and system division of labor are not stated [15]. |
### Scenario entry suggestions
| Scenario | Recommended R&S combination | Entry point | Unverified items |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cellular modem / chipset R&D bring-up | R&S CMX500 | Use CMX500 as the one-box signaling tester for LTE, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, NR/LTE signaling, RF measurements, fading, throughput and automation [1][2] | Semiconductor-specific package and priority ranking are not stated. |
| Application and IP-stack validation | R&S CMX500 with CMX-KA100 / KA110 / KA150 / KA180 / KA181 / KA401 where applicable | Validate DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, IP traffic, IMS voice codecs, POLQA and audio delay [3] | Required license bundle for a specific customer is not stated. |
| NR-NTN chipset / conformance preparation | R&S TS8980 + R&S TS-RRM + R&S CMX500 | Use the R&S conformance setup context where NR-NTN FR1 measurements cover RF, RRM and PCT domains and have been conducted with a Samsung NR-NTN chipset DUT [14] | Concrete RRM test case IDs and platform split are not stated [15]. |
| Wi‑Fi / cellular convergence | R&S CMX500 / CMX500 OBT | Address WLAN signaling, Wi‑Fi 7, Wi‑Fi/cellular traffic offloading, N3IWF and POLQA voice quality measurement [2][16][17] | Semiconductor-specific Wi‑Fi chipset qualification flow is not stated. |
| OTA signaling validation | R&S CMX500 OBT integrated with MVG or Bluetest OTA systems | Run 4G, 5G and WLAN OTA signaling testing, including Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA EN-DC, RedCap and LTE FDD/TDD [11][19][20] | Chamber configuration, calibration flow and pricing are not stated. |
### Inferences
【推論】For semiconductor teams acting as chip vendors in the 5G device value chain, CMX500 should be positioned around multi-RAT signaling and network emulation because chip-vendor workflows include signaling/protocol/application/OTA/conformance test types and CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD signaling/device testing capabilities [1][2][4][32].
【推論】For modem application validation, CMX500 application/IP/IMS/audio features are a key attach because application testing is part of the 5G device value chain and CMX500 application options cover IP services, QoS/ePDG/N3IWF, IP analysis, IMS codecs, POLQA and audio-delay tools [3][31][32].
【推論】For semiconductor programs targeting NTN and Wi‑Fi, emphasize CMX500/OBT plus R&S conformance or OTA systems because R&S has NR-NTN chipset validation context with Samsung, CMX500 has Wi‑Fi 7/Wi‑Fi 8 signaling-related capability, and CMX500 OBT supports 4G/5G/WLAN OTA signaling integrations [14][17][19][22].
